description.value: K'awat'si Charters is a wholly Indigenous-owned and operated fishing charter company based in Port Hardy on Vancouver Island's north coast, rooted in the traditions of the Gwa'sa̱la-'Nak̓waxda'x̱w Nations. The company offers guided salmon and halibut fishing adventures in small groups of up to four guests, alongside cultural experiences such as the Nakwakto Rapids and Cultural Tour. A touring cyclist passing through Port Hardy could add a memorable ocean excursion to their trip, with local transportation available from Kwa'lilas Hotel.
